name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper's standard mutual NDA terms, allowing two parties to exchange confidential information under agreed protections, exceptions, and return/destruction obligations.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: The cover page used to execute the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing purpose, effective date, term, and governing law details that incorporate the Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms for a SaaS/cloud service provider-customer relationship, covering access and use, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms for giving an early-access design partner use of a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a product development program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms defining uptime targets, support response times, service credit remedies, and termination rights for cloud service performance commitments.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms for a provider performing professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, IP assignment, payment, and warranties.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and processor/subprocessor, including international transfer mechanisms (EEA SCCs, UK Addendum) and security incident response.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms for an on-premises or installed software license, covering license grants, restrictions, updates, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms for a business partnership involving mutual obligations, trademark licensing, fees, and confidentiality between a company and a partner.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard HIPAA business associate agreement terms, covering permitted uses and disclosures of PHI, safeguards, subcontractors, and breach notification.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard terms for a time-limited product pilot or evaluation period, covering access rights, restrictions, warranties, and liability ahead of a definitive agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper's standard addendum supplementing a product agreement with AI-specific terms covering input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-related disclaimers.
